title: facade.rs is 9,403 lines across 156 functions (median 28) -- same flat shape as render.rs, split post-tag
body:
## CORRECTED BEFORE ANYONE ACTED ON IT -- THE ORIGINAL HEADLINE WAS AN ARTEFACT OF MY OWN GREP

**This issue was filed saying facade.rs held 19 functions of ~258 code lines each and was "the worse of the two". That is FALSE and the error was mine.** The count came from `grep -cE '^(pub )?(async )?fn '`, which sees only column-zero definitions. **facade.rs has 156 functions; 137 of them live inside 6 `impl` blocks and were invisible to that pattern.**

**I had declared the limit as a caveat in the original filing and then drove it, which is the only reason this is a correction rather than a wrong record somebody planned against.** A caveat that sits above a table nobody re-reads is decoration.

## What is actually true

| | render.rs | facade.rs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| lines | 10,570 | 9,403 |
| functions | 161 | **156** |
| **median function** | **35** | **28** |
| p90 / max | 150 / 337 | **124 / 749** |

**THEY ARE THE SAME SHAPE.** Both are flat surfaces of small functions living in one oversized file. facade.rs's median function is if anything SMALLER than render.rs's. **Neither is a god object, and the "258 lines per function" figure never described anything real.**

So the remedy is the same as `0289`'s and for the same reason: **split by boundary, do not refactor.** No logic moves.

## What survives from the original filing

- **facade.rs is the seam every surface goes through** -- CLI, daemon, MCP and TUI all reach the store through it, and D06 makes it the only crate that may touch `rusqlite`. A wrong cut changes the one boundary the dependency graph enforces. That was true before this correction and is unaffected by it.
- **The single 749-line outlier is worth a look on its own**, independent of any split. It is the only function in either file over 400.
- **Post-tag, behind `0289`.** hv has twice declined real work in a tag window on this shape (`AC-09.6`'s 21 facades; the `bin/` prune).

## What does NOT survive

- **"The worse of the two" is withdrawn.** It rested entirely on the bad denominator.
- **"Read the 19 functions before proposing a shape" is withdrawn as posed** -- there are 156 and the shape question is now the same mechanical one as render.rs's.

## The shape, because it is the third instance in one day

**A correct measurement of the wrong population, producing a confident headline with no tell.** The grep ran, returned a real number, and the number described column-zero definitions rather than functions. **The discriminator was available for free and I nearly shipped without it: state the population, then take it a second way** -- `^\s*fn` against `^fn` differ by 137 here.
